items.informal_name: Variable corresponding to index n in multivariate polynomial ring
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → σ → MvPolynomial σ R
items.informal_description: The variable corresponding to the index $ n $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $, represented as the monomial with coefficient 1 and exponent 1 on the variable $ n $, and exponent 0 on all other variables in $ \sigma $.

items.informal_description: For each index $ i $ in $ \sigma $, the algebra homomorphism from the univariate polynomial ring $ R[X] $ to the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ maps the indeterminate $ X $ to the $ i $-th variable $ X_i $ in $ R[\sigma] $.

items.informal_name: Multivariate polynomial ring over R in variables σ
items.type: Type u_1 → (R : Type u_2) → [CommSemiring R] → Type (max u_2 u_1)
items.informal_description: The ring of multivariate polynomials with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, where variables are indexed by a type $ \sigma $. Each polynomial is a finite $ R $-linear combination of monomials, represented by finite support functions from $ \sigma $ to $ \mathbb{N} $. Multiplication is defined via the additive monoid operation on exponents (i.e., monomial multiplication corresponds to adding exponent vectors).
